The place has a nice, chill vibe, like a Korean-style cafe. The dentist was very respectful of the patients. I went for a filling, and it was a tooth-colored filling. The work was quite good.

On the day I went, the dentist seemed a little harsh with the assistant (the dentist might have been stressed because mistakes can cause significant damage; I understand). It's a delicate job, and assistants can make mistakes. This case involved the assistant blocking the light used for the oral examination. As a patient, I could forgive it. It was a relaxed atmosphere. I believe the clinic and all the staff are committed to improving.

Parking:
There's only parking for 1-2 cars, but plenty for motorcycles. It's a small, cute place, and visitors can easily find parking nearby.
